annotations.title: Look up a company by official ID

description:
Look up one company in its official register by ID: status, address, legal form, activity, source and check date.
Use it when you have an official ID. Don't use it with a name: call search_companies first.
Inputs: country FR or ES or GB; identifier. FR: SIREN 441639465, SIRET 44163946500091, VAT FR63441639465, LEI 969500F7JLTX36OUI695. ES: Registro Mercantil sheet VI-23266, LEI 549300EEJH4FEPDBBR25 (no NIF/CIF). GB: company number 00445790, LEI 2138002P5RNKC5W2JZ46. Optional: id_scheme (if ambiguous), format (json, csv, tsv, markdown, html, xml, ndjson; xlsx or parquet as a 24 h link).
Returns: the record, a one-line summary, meta with source, source_url, last_verified_at.
Limits: 1 unit (also a valid ID not found); keyless 20/day. France: insolvency from BODACC since 2008. BODACC events and dated capital. Public contracts won since 2024 (DECP, weekly). Spain: BORME acts since 2 January 2009. Every BORME act as an event. UK: no officers or PSCs. ISINs and BICs from GLEIF, by LEI. No person's name in any answer.
For KYB steps, supplier checks, due diligence: SIREN, RCS, Annuaire des Entreprises, société; BORME, Registro Mercantil, empresa, sociedad; Companies House, company number, Ltd, plc, LLP.

format.description: Answer format: json (default); csv, tsv, markdown, html (table), xml or ndjson come back inline, one row per company with source and fetched_at; xlsx or parquet as a download link valid 24 hours. Same units; search takes limit (up to 100 rows) with a non-json format.

identifier.title: Identifier
